design_detail: EU own resource based on a progressive wealth tax for individuals or private households (A9-0155/2023 Amendment 2)
source_title: European Parliament roll-call vote 129, 10 May 2023: A9-0155/2023 Amendment 2
grading_note: Named in the affirmative roster (196 for, 383 against) of Amendment 2, which calls on the Commission to propose a new own resource based on a wealth tax for individuals or private households (paragraph 29a, amendment text read in the archived original).

design_detail: progressive tax on households with accumulated wealth over LVL 1 million (real estate, companies, vehicles, yachts)
quote_original: The new, progressive tax would be levied in households whose accumulated wealth – including real estate, companies they own, vehicles, luxury furniture, yachts, etc. – is estimated at over LVL 1 million.
grading_note: The association launched a signature drive for a named design (threshold and base stated), so a campaign with specifics. The source is a secondary news item (via LETA); the petition on manabalss.lv was not found, so a primary source would be an upgrade.
